# Coradoc AsciiDoc grammar — PARG port (parsanol-ruby#129 acceptance).
#
# Translation of coradoc-adoc/lib/coradoc/asciidoc/parser (Ruby Parsanol
# DSL) to .parg. Ported incrementally; each rule family cites its Ruby
# source. The motivating runtime-state patterns (fence capture + dynamic
# close, from Parser::Block#block_style / #markdown_code_block) map onto
# set/state exactly as designed in parsanol-ruby#129.
#
# Increment 1 scope: terminals, attribute lists (faithful capture
# shapes), element ids, block titles, block headers, all delimited
# block styles (verbatim content), comments/tags/includes, document
# dispatch subset with the unparsed catch-all.

grammar CoradocAdoc version "0.2.0" {

  # ---- text.rb terminals ----
  any_char = %x01-10FFFF
  space = 1*" "
  sp = [1*" "]
  text = 1*(!"\n" any_char)
  line_ending = ("\n" / "\r\n")
  newline = 1*("\n" / "\r\n")
  empty_line = "\n"
  keyword = 1*(%x41-5A / %x61-7A / %x30-39 / "_" / "-" / "." / ",")
  file_path = 1*(!"[" any_char)

  # ---- attribute_list.rb (faithful capture shapes) ----
  named_key = (1*(%x41-5A / %x61-7A / %x30-39 / "_" / "-")) as named_key

  named_value_sq = %x27 (1*(!(%x27) any_char)) %x27
  named_value_dq = %x22 (1*(!(%x22) any_char)) %x22
  named_value_noquote = 1*(!(%x5D / %x2C) any_char)
  named_value = ((named_value_sq / named_value_dq / named_value_noquote)) as named_value

  named_attribute = ((named_key [space] "=" [space] named_value [space])) as named

  positional_value_sq = %x27 (1*(!(%x27) any_char)) %x27
  positional_value_dq = %x22 (1*(!(%x22) any_char)) %x22
  positional_value_unquoted = 1*(!(%x5D / %x2C / %x3D) any_char)
  positional_attribute = (((positional_value_sq / positional_value_dq / positional_value_unquoted) !(%x3D))) as positional

  named_many = ((1*1(named_attribute)) [*(%x2C [space] named_attribute)])
  positional_one_named_many = ((1*1(positional_attribute)) 1*(%x2C [space] named_attribute))
  positional_many_named_many = ((1*1(positional_attribute)) 1*(%x2C [space] positional_attribute) 1*(%x2C [space] named_attribute))
  positional_many = ((1*1(positional_attribute)) [*(%x2C [space] positional_attribute)])
  positional_zero_or_one = 0*1(positional_attribute)

  attribute_list = (&(%x5B) %x5B !(%x5B) (((((named_many / positional_one_named_many / positional_many_named_many / positional_many / positional_zero_or_one))) as attribute_array)) as attribute_list %x5D)

  # ---- content.rb: element_id / block_header.rb ----
  element_id = ((("[[" (keyword) as id "]]") / ("[#" (keyword) as id "]")) newline)

  attribute_blocks = (1*((attribute_list newline))) as attribute_list

  # ---- block.rb: delimiters + title ----
  block_delim_run = 4*((%x2A / %x3D / %x5F / %x2B / %x2E / %x2D))
  block_delimiter = ((block_delim_run / (2%x2D) / (3*%x60)) newline)
  block_title = (!(block_delimiter) %x2E !(space) (text) as title newline)

  block_header = [(block_title)] [(element_id)] [(attribute_blocks)]

  # ---- text.rb: comment_line / tag / comment_block / include ----
  tag_shape = ("//" !( "/") [1*" "] ("tag" / "end") "::" !( ":") 1*(!"[" any_char))

  comment_line_content = (!(tag_shape) "//" !("/") [1*" "] *(!"\n" any_char) line_ending)

  comment_line = (!(tag_shape) ("//" !("/") [1*" "] [(text) as comment_text line_ending as line_break])) as comment_line

  tag = (("//" !("/") [1*" "] ("tag" / "end") as prefix "::" !(":") ((1*(!"[" any_char))) as name attribute_list [newline] as line_break)) as tag

  comment_block = (("////" line_ending (*(!((line_ending "////")) any_char)) as comment_text line_ending "////")) as comment_block

  include_directive = (("include::" file_path as path attribute_list [newline] as line_break)) as include

  # ---- content.rb text_line(verbatim:) : text + own line ending ----
  # tl >> (line_ending.as(:line_break) | eof?) — the newline rides INSIDE
  # the same iteration hash (parslet sequence merge), matching the DSL.
  verbatim_line = (((1*(!"\n" any_char)) as text) ((line_ending) as line_break / (!(any_char))))

  # ---- block.rb: delimited blocks (the #129 state patterns) ----
  # markdown_code_block: 3+ backticks, optional language, closes with the
  # SAME fence run (Parser::Block#markdown_code_block).
  state md_fence: string
  md_lang = [*" " (1*(%x41-5A / %x61-7A / %x30-39 / "_" / "+" / "-" / ".")) as language]
  md_close = (state md_fence [space] newline)
  md_content = (!(md_close) verbatim_line)
  md_break = (empty_line as line_break)
  markdown_code_block = (block_header ((set md_fence = (3*%x60)) as delimiter md_lang newline (1*(md_content / md_break)) as lines [space] (state md_fence) [space] newline))

  # block_style: 4+ identical fence chars, closes with the exact same run.
  state eq_fence: string
  state dash_fence: string
  state us_fence: string
  state ast_fence: string
  state plus_fence: string
  state dot_fence: string

  eq_content = (!(((state eq_fence) newline)) verbatim_line)
  dash_content = (!(((state dash_fence) newline)) verbatim_line)
  us_content = (!(((state us_fence) newline)) verbatim_line)
  ast_content = (!(((state ast_fence) newline)) verbatim_line)
  plus_content = (!(((state plus_fence) newline)) verbatim_line)
  dot_content = (!(((state dot_fence) newline)) verbatim_line)
  vbreak = (empty_line as line_break)

  example_block = (block_header ((set eq_fence = (4*%x3D)) as delimiter newline (1*(eq_content / vbreak)) as lines (state eq_fence) newline))
  source_block = (block_header ((set dash_fence = (4*%x2D)) as delimiter newline (1*(dash_content / vbreak)) as lines (state dash_fence) newline))
  quote_block = (block_header ((set us_fence = (4*%x5F)) as delimiter newline (1*(us_content / vbreak)) as lines (state us_fence) newline))
  sidebar_block = (block_header ((set ast_fence = (4*%x2A)) as delimiter newline (1*(ast_content / vbreak)) as lines (state ast_fence) newline))
  pass_block = (block_header ((set plus_fence = (4*%x2B)) as delimiter newline (1*(plus_content / vbreak)) as lines (state plus_fence) newline))
  literal_block = (block_header ((set dot_fence = (4*%x2E)) as delimiter newline (1*(dot_content / vbreak)) as lines (state dot_fence) newline))

  # block_style_exact: open block — EXACTLY 2 dashes
  state open_fence: string
  open_content = (!(((state open_fence) newline)) verbatim_line)
  open_block = (block_header ((set open_fence = (2%x2D)) as delimiter newline (1*(open_content / vbreak)) as lines (state open_fence) newline))

  block = ((markdown_code_block / example_block / sidebar_block / source_block / quote_block / pass_block / literal_block / open_block)) as block

  # ---- inline.rb (INLINE_RULE_ORDER is load-bearing) ----
  typographic_quote = ((%x22 %x60) / (%x60 %x22) / (%x27 %x60) / (%x60 %x27)) as typographic_quote

  attribute_reference = (&(%x7B) %x7B ((1*(%x41-5A / %x61-7A / %x30-39 / "_" / "-"))) as attribute_reference %x7D)

  uri_char = (%x41-5A / %x61-7A / %x30-39 / "_" / "." / "-" / ":" / "/" / "&" / "?" / "=" / "+" / "," / "%" / "#" / "~" / ";")

  link_tail = (((1*uri_char)) as path [(%x5B ((1*(!(%x5D) any_char))) as text %x5D)])
  link = ((&(("http" / "https" / "ftp")) link_tail) as link / (&("link:") "link:" link_tail) as link)

  inline_image = (&("image:") "image:" !(":") ((1*uri_char)) as path [attribute_list]) as inline_image

  inline_passthrough = ((("+++" ((1*(!("+++") !(%x0A) any_char))) as raw "+++")) as inline_passthrough / (&("pass:") "pass:" *(%x41-5A / %x61-7A / %x2B / %x2C) %x5B ((1*(!("]]") !(%x5D / %x0A) any_char))) as raw %x5D) as inline_passthrough)

  underline = (attribute_list %x5B ".underline" %x5D as role %x23 ((1*(!(%x23 / %x0A) any_char))) as text %x23) as underline
  small = (attribute_list %x5B ".small" %x5D as role %x23 ((1*(!(%x23 / %x0A) any_char))) as text %x23) as small

  hard_line_break = (((" +" %x0A) / (%x5C %x0A))) as hard_line_break

  term_type = ("term" / "alt" / "deprecated" / "domain") as term_type
  stem_type = ("stem" / "latexmath" / "asciimath") as stem_type

  escaped_xref = (%x5C (%x3C %x3C) as text)
  cross_reference = (((%x3C %x3C) ((1*(!((%x2C / %x3E)) any_char)) as href) [((%x2C) ((*(!((%x3E)) any_char)) as text))] (%x3E %x3E)) as cross_reference)

  term_inline = (term_type ":[" ((1*(!(%x5D) any_char))) as term %x5D)
  term_inline2 = (%x5B term_type %x5D %x23 ((1*(!(%x23) any_char))) as term2 %x23)

  macro_kw = ("term" / "alt" / "deprecated" / "domain" / "stem" / "latexmath" / "asciimath")
  macro_content = 1*((!(macro_kw) !(%x5D) any_char) / (macro_kw %x3A %x5B macro_content %x5D))
  footnote = ("footnote:" [(keyword) as id] %x5B ((macro_content)) as footnote %x5D)

  stem = (stem_type ":[" ((1*(!(%x5D) any_char))) as content %x5D) as stem

  # constrained/unstrained marks — content keeps Ruby's .as(:text).repeat(1,1)
  # array wrap (1*1) except where Ruby uses a bare .as
  bold_constrained = ((%x2A !(%x2A) (1*1(((1*(!(%x2A / %x0A) any_char))) as text)) %x2A !(%x2A)) !(%x0A %x0A)) as bold_constrained
  bold_unconstrained = ((%x2A %x2A (1*1(((1*(!(%x2A) any_char))) as text)) %x2A %x2A)) as bold_unconstrained
  span_constrained = (attribute_list %x23 ((1*(!(%x23 / %x0A) any_char))) as text %x23 !(%x23)) as span_constrained
  span_unconstrained = (attribute_list %x23 %x23 ((1*(!(%x23 / %x0A) any_char))) as text %x23 %x23) as span_unconstrained
  italic_constrained = ((%x5F !(%x5F) (1*1(((1*(!(%x5F / %x0A) any_char))) as text)) %x5F !(%x5F))) as italic_constrained
  italic_unconstrained = ((%x5F %x5F (1*1(((1*(!(%x5F) any_char))) as text)) %x5F %x5F)) as italic_unconstrained
  highlight_constrained = ((%x23 !(%x23) (1*1(((1*(!(%x23 / %x0A) any_char))) as text)) %x23 !(%x23))) as highlight_constrained
  highlight_unconstrained = ((%x23 %x23 (1*1(((1*(!(%x23) any_char))) as text)) %x23 %x23)) as highlight_unconstrained
  monospace_constrained = ((%x60 !(%x60) (1*1((1*((!(%x60 / %x0A) any_char) / (%x60 %x60))) as text)) %x60 !(%x60))) as monospace_constrained
  monospace_unconstrained = ((%x60 %x60 (1*1(((1*(!(%x60) any_char))) as text)) %x60 %x60)) as monospace_unconstrained
  superscript = (%x5E (1*1(((1*(!(%x5E / %x0A) any_char))) as text)) %x5E) as superscript
  subscript = (%x7E (1*1(((1*(!(%x7E / %x0A) any_char))) as text)) %x7E) as subscript

  inline = (typographic_quote / bold_unconstrained / bold_constrained / span_unconstrained / span_constrained / italic_unconstrained / italic_constrained / highlight_unconstrained / highlight_constrained / monospace_unconstrained / monospace_constrained / superscript / subscript / attribute_reference / escaped_xref / cross_reference / term_inline / term_inline2 / footnote / stem / link / inline_image / inline_passthrough / underline / small / hard_line_break)

  # text.rb/inline.rb text layers
  inline_chars = ((%x5B / %x2A / %x5F / %x7B / %x3C / %x5E / %x7E / %x60) / typographic_quote / "https" / "http" / "link:" / "image:" / "+++" / "pass:" / term_type / "footnote" / stem_type / (%x5C %x3C %x3C) / hard_line_break)
  text_formatted = (&(inline_chars) inline)
  text_unformatted = 1*(!("\\" %x3C %x3C) !(inline) !(%x0A) any_char)
  text_any = ((2*((text_formatted / (text_unformatted) as text))) / (1*1(text_formatted)) / text_unformatted)

  # ---- paragraph.rb ----
  # NOTE: list.absent? from line_not_text? is pending the list.rb port;
  # guard truth diverges only on real list lines (none in this corpus).
  literal_space = 1*(%x20 / %x09)
  section_prefix = (%x3D *(%x3D) any_char)
  list_prefix = (((%x2A 1*5(%x2A)) / (%x2E 1*5(%x2E))) " ")
  line_not_text = (!(list_1) !(list_prefix) !(list_continuation) !((attribute_list newline)) !(block_delimiter) !((%x7C %x3D %x3D %x3D newline)) !(element_id) !(comment_line) !(tag) !(section_prefix))
  asciidoc_char = (%x2A / %x5F / %x3A / %x2B / %x3D / %x2D)
  asciidoc_char_with_id = (asciidoc_char / (%x5B %x23) / (%x5B %x5B))
  element_id_inline = ((%x5B %x5B (keyword) as id %x5D %x5D) / (%x5B %x23 (keyword) as id %x5D))
  # paragraph_text_line(0|false|true): guard, text_any, then the
  # three-state newline tail (0 = eof only; false = single; true = many)
  # Ruby's (a.absent? | element_id_inline | line_not_text?) reduces under
  # the outer line_not_text guard: arms 1/3 always hold there, and
  # element_id_inline implies asciidoc_char_with_id — so it's just an
  # optional inline id (keeps zero-width branches out of the alternation)
  ptl_guard = (line_not_text [(element_id_inline) [*literal_space]])
  paragraph_text_line_0 = (ptl_guard ((text_any)) as text (!(any_char)))
  paragraph_text_line_s = (ptl_guard ((text_any)) as text ((line_ending) as line_break / (!(any_char))))
  paragraph_text_line_m = (ptl_guard ((text_any)) as text ((newline) as line_break / (!(any_char))))
  paragraph = (block_header ((((1*1(paragraph_text_line_0)) ((newline) as line_break / (!(any_char)))) / ((1*(paragraph_text_line_s)) [(1*1(paragraph_text_line_m) ((newline) as line_break / (!(any_char))))]))) as lines *(newline)) as paragraph

  # ---- admonition.rb ----
  admonition_type = (%i"note" / %i"tip" / %i"warning" / %i"caution" / %i"important" / %i"editor" / %i"todo" / %i"admonition")
  admonition_line = ((admonition_type as admonition_type) ": " ((1*((text_any as text) (line_ending as line_break))) as content))

  # ---- list.rb (nesting levels unrolled 1..5) ----
  list_continuation = ("+" %x0A)
  list_item_separator = (*(comment_line_content / empty_line))
  ulist_marker_1 = ( ((1%x2A !(%x2A) !("===")) / (%x2D !(%x2D) !(%x30-39))))
  olist_marker_1 = ( 1%x2E !(%x2E) !((*((%x30-39 / %x2E / %x3C / %x3E / %x5E) / %x2B)) "|"))
  list_marker_1 = (olist_marker_1 / ulist_marker_1)
  ulist_marker_2 = ([*literal_space] (2%x2A !(%x2A) !("===")))
  olist_marker_2 = ([*literal_space] 2%x2E !(%x2E) !((*((%x30-39 / %x2E / %x3C / %x3E / %x5E) / %x2B)) "|"))
  list_marker_2 = (olist_marker_2 / ulist_marker_2)
  ulist_marker_3 = ([*literal_space] (3%x2A !(%x2A) !("===")))
  olist_marker_3 = ([*literal_space] 3%x2E !(%x2E) !((*((%x30-39 / %x2E / %x3C / %x3E / %x5E) / %x2B)) "|"))
  list_marker_3 = (olist_marker_3 / ulist_marker_3)
  ulist_marker_4 = ([*literal_space] (4%x2A !(%x2A) !("===")))
  olist_marker_4 = ([*literal_space] 4%x2E !(%x2E) !((*((%x30-39 / %x2E / %x3C / %x3E / %x5E) / %x2B)) "|"))
  list_marker_4 = (olist_marker_4 / ulist_marker_4)
  ulist_marker_5 = ([*literal_space] (5%x2A !(%x2A) !("===")))
  olist_marker_5 = ([*literal_space] 5%x2E !(%x2E) !((*((%x30-39 / %x2E / %x3C / %x3E / %x5E) / %x2B)) "|"))
  list_marker_5 = (olist_marker_5 / ulist_marker_5)
  inline_lb = (typographic_quote / bold_unconstrained / bold_constrained / span_unconstrained / span_constrained / italic_unconstrained / italic_constrained / highlight_unconstrained / highlight_constrained / monospace_unconstrained / monospace_constrained / superscript / subscript / attribute_reference / escaped_xref / cross_reference / term_inline / term_inline2 / footnote / stem / link / inline_image / inline_passthrough / underline / small)
  list_body_hard_break = ((" +" %x0A) / (%x5C %x0A))
  list_body_text_unformatted = (1*(!("\\<<") !(inline_lb) !(list_body_hard_break) !(%x0A) any_char))
  list_body_text_any = (1*(inline_lb / (list_body_text_unformatted as text)))
  list_body_line_ending = (((" +" as hard_line_break) (line_ending as line_break)) / (line_ending as line_break) / !(any_char))
  list_body_text_line = ([*literal_space] (list_body_text_any as text) list_body_line_ending)
  list_item_continuation_lines = (*(line_not_text list_body_text_line))
  list_attached_block = (admonition_line / unordered_list_1 / ordered_list_1 / paragraph / block)
  list_item_attached = ((*(&(list_continuation) list_continuation list_attached_block)) as attached)
